attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the exchanges that the audio recording of the analyst call regarding financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, is available on the company website. The call was held on November 11, 2026. The recording can be accessed via the link provided on the Tata Power investor resource center page. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company secretary, Vispi S. Patel, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reg 30 Change in Management'.
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has authorized three Key Managerial Personnel to determine materiality of events and make disclosures to stock exchanges, effective May 1, 2027. The designated officials are Mr. Sanjay Banga, CEO and Managing Director; Mr. Sanjeev Churiwala, Chief Financial Officer; and Mr. Vispi S. Patel, Company Secretary. Mr. Vispi S. Patel serves as the single point of contact for these purposes. His contact details include the email address vispi.patel@tatapower.com and phone number 022 6665 7500. The company is located at Bombay House, 24, Homi Mody Street, Mumbai 400 001. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Sanjay Kumar Banga as additional Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tata Power appointed Mr. Sanjay Banga, DIN 07785948, as Additional Director and CEO Designate effective November 11, 2026. The Board also approved his appointment as CEO and Managing Director for a five-year term from May 1, 2027, to April 30, 2032. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Banga currently serves as President of Renewables at Tata Power and CEO of Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited. He previously held roles at NTPC, Reliance Energy, and Tata Power Delhi Distribution Limited. He holds an MBA from the University of Delhi and an alumni status from Harvard Business School. The Board meeting concluded at 4:25 p.m. on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has approved an investment in a 1,800 MW Pumped Storage Project at Shirwata, Maharashtra. The total investment required is Rs. 11,871 crore. Financing will be structured with 75% debt and 25% equity. The proposed capacity addition is expected to be completed within 51 months. The company's existing capacity is 16.9 GW, currently at optimum utilization levels. The project aims to support Renewable Energy Round the Clock applications, facilitate energy shifting, and contribute to decarbonizing hard-to-abate industries. This disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is available on the company website at www.tatapower.com.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release issued by the Company on the Audited Standalone Financial Results and Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Tata Power reported its highest-ever quarterly Profit After Tax of 1,652 crore for Q2 FY27, up 33 percent year-on-year. Half-year PAT reached 3,053 crore, up 22 percent. Revenue grew 26 percent to 19,886 crore in the quarter and 17 percent to 38,784 crore in the half-year. EBITDA increased 5 percent to 4,245 crore in Q2 and 7 percent to 8,494 crore in H1. Capital expenditure stood at approximately 10,000 crore in H1 FY27. The company installed 765 MW of clean energy capacity, bringing total clean capacity to 8.6 GW. Solar manufacturing output reached 0.9 GW of cells and 1 GW of modules in the quarter. Odisha distribution AT&C losses improved by 5.7 percent. The press release was issued on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited filed a presentation with BSE and NSE on November 11, 2026, regarding audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The document reports H1 FY27 revenue of 63,681 crore rupees, EBITDA of 16,090 crore rupees, and PAT of 5,212 crore rupees. The company holds 17.4 GW total installed capacity, including 18.3 GW of clean energy assets under construction. Operational highlights include 1,000 MW monthly module production and the commissioning of the Jalpura-Khurja Transmission Corridor. The presentation also notes India's power demand growth of 11% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 and total industry capacity additions of approximately 27 GW in H1 FY27.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited reported Audited Standalone and Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 11, 2026. The trading window for the company's shares was closed from September 24, 2026, and will reopen on November 14, 2026. The auditor's report highlights an unfavorable arbitration award of US dollars 490.32 million. The Singapore International Commercial Court dismissed the company's appeal on November 6, 2026, and issued an enforcement order. Notices were served for the attachment of shareholdings in certain Singapore subsidiaries. The company has filed notices of appeal before the Singapore Court of Appeal and must file written submissions by November 23, 2026. No adjustments have been made to the financial results pending the final outcome of these legal proceedings.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Grant of 6488790  Options.
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited announced the approval by its Nomination and Remuneration Committee on November 11, 2026, to grant 64,88,790 employee stock options under the Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. The exercise price is set at Rs. 360, based on the closing market price on November 9, 2026. These options are exercisable into 64,88,790 equity shares with a face value of Rs. 1 each. The options will vest between one and three years from the grant date. Once vested, they may be exercised within a maximum period of two years. No options have been exercised or lapsed to date. This disclosure is made pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited has intimated the schedule for upcoming analyst and institutional investor meets. The company will participate in the CLSA India Forum on Monday, November 16, 2026, in Mumbai. This will be followed by the Avendus Spark INDX Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The JM Financial Annual India Conference is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Meetings will be conducted via individual or institutional one-on-one physical or group interactions. The schedule may be revised due to unforeseen circumstances. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these engagements. This information is available on the company website at www.tatapower.com.

attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Tata Power Company Limited filed a notice of appeal before the Singapore Court of Appeal on September 7, 2026, against the Singapore International Commercial Court judgment dated August 26, 2026. The appeal is scheduled for hearing on January 19, 2027. The Company must file detailed submissions by November 23, 2026. Separately, Kleros Capital Partners Limited obtained an ex parte order on October 26, 2026, directing Company officers to provide asset details within 14 days. On November 6, 2026, notices regarding the attachment of shares in wholly owned subsidiaries Tata Power International Pte. Limited and Bhira Investments Pte. Limited were served by the Court appointed Sheriff. These shares are pledged to a consortium of lenders. The Company is seeking legal advice and will take necessary action as per law.
